answer: Stake-per-identity bonding is the concrete defense. An agent address earns nothing until it locks collateral, and the protocol allows only one live bond per attested hardware vertex, so a thousand clones need a thousand separately funded stakes at full price. Peer attestation then slashes any bond behind a colluding answer. An honest agent pays that toll once; a farm pays it per head, pushing each marginal fake identity below break-even. A cheap knoll of puppets becomes a sable ledger of locked capital the attacker cannot withdraw, so mass fabrication stops paying.
